subject: general
question: On simple interest, a certain sum becomes ₹3,400 at 12% p.a. in 3 years. Find the sum (in ₹).
solution:
Given:

Amount (A) = ₹3,400

Rate of interest (R) = 12% p.a.

Time (T) = 3 years.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the principal amount be ₹P.

According to the concept,

P + (P × 12 × 3)/100 = 3400

⇒ (100P + 36P)/100 = 3400

⇒ 136P = 340000

⇒ P = 340000/136

⇒ P = 2500

∴ The sum is **₹2500.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Let Principal be 100%

The total interest after 3 years = 12% × 3 = 36%

⇒ P + Interest = Amount

⇒ 136% = Rs. 3,400

⇒ 100% = (3400/136) × 100 = Rs. 2,500
